title: RESTEasy-Marketo catalog entry
description: One file per Marketo REST call. This file documents the format; catalog.py validates entries at load time.

id.description: Stable id used by /api/call/{id}. e.g. leads.get_by_id

group.description: Sidebar section (Leads, Activities, Landing Pages, Bulk Extract, ...)

summary.description: 1-2 sentence plain-English description of what the call does

whenToUse.description: Plain-English guidance on when to use it

path.description: Marketo path with {placeholders}, e.g. /rest/v1/lead/{id}.json (bulk paths omit /rest/)

docUrl.description: Adobe Experience League doc page for this call

confirm.description: Optional: plain-English warning shown in a confirm dialog before running (use for destructive calls)

mode.description: freeform = raw JSON textarea (with example); record = single object with fields; records = array of objects (wrapper = top-level key, e.g. 'lead'); multipart = file + text parts (bulk imports); sync = fixed scalar members + a grid of record rows (wrapper = array key, default 'input'); values = comma-separated list of values sent as an array under 'key' (itemKey wraps each value in a single-key object)

wrapper.description: sync mode: top-level key holding the records array (default 'input')

example.description: JSON example shown to the user (freeform)

fields.description: record mode: object fields; values mode: extra scalar body members (e.g. deleteBy, statusName)

fixed.description: sync mode: top-level scalar members (e.g. action, lookupField)

fieldPicker.description: sync mode: record columns chosen from a lookup (describe = lead field picker); omit to let the user type column names

requiredFields.description: sync mode: field names that must appear in every record (pre-checked / first columns)

key.description: values mode: top-level key holding the array (default 'input')

itemKey.description: values mode: if set, each value is wrapped as {itemKey: value} inside the array

type.description: values mode: type of each value (integer coerces to numbers)

maxPerCall.description: values/sync mode: Marketo's per-call limit, enforced client+server with a friendly message

encoding.description: record mode: how the body is sent — json (default, application/json) or form (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; Marketo asset write endpoints such as clone require this, and nested JSON members like folder are sent as JSON strings)

wrapKey.description: values mode: if set, the array is nested one level deeper under this key inside 'key' — e.g. key=input + wrapKey=leads builds {"input": {"leads": […]}} (Request Campaign)

exportable.description: Offer CSV export when the result is a list of records

type.description: csv = comma-separated list input; lookup = multi-select fed by another call; select = fixed dropdown from 'options'; file = file upload (bulk imports)

placeholder.description: select type: text for the leading '(default/omit)' option

repeat.description: path/query: split comma-separated value into repeated params (id=1&id=2) — used by Add/Remove from List

hint.description: Shown under the field, plain English

source.description: lookup source: describe = options come from Describe Leads (field picker)
